statement: Written after grading, before publication. The addendum is left unchanged and still records the file that was graded. A last check of that file found Xbox account identifiers (XUIDs) that the sanitiser had not removed: in sign TextOwner fields and written-book xuid tags, and, physically, in LevelDB entries deleted by the sanitiser but not yet compacted away (RealmsStoriesData* keys and values) and in the MANIFEST. The published source is the same world with those identifiers removed. No assertion, verdict or count changed.

derivation.rule: each account id replaced by a fixed 16-character pseudonym, 0000000000000001 upwards in order of first appearance in key order; same id, same pseudonym; the mapping is not recorded
derivation.database: rebuilt from its 2 110 791 live entries; every key and every other value byte-identical (checked by the script by reading both databases back); deleted entries no longer present
derivation.checked_on_published_file: raw scan of every table block, log and MANIFEST: 0 XUID-like value, 0 RealmsStoriesData key, 0 player_<id> identity record, 0 MsaId / SelfSignedId / PlatformOnlineId / PlatformOfflineId field, 0 e-mail-like value, 0 of the 64 account ids listed for the original world's players; the 3 written-book xuid tags hold pseudonyms

published.built_from: published_source, with the frozen tools (reports/gurren/run-gurren.sh freeze)

fixtures.check: graded content with the header source_sha256 replaced and the same 176 id strings replaced is byte-identical to the published content; same 2 025 895 subjects

results.note: the per-assertion files carry the same substitution (id strings inside evidence); summary.json, the COMPARISON tables and every status are unchanged. summary.json keeps the hashes of the files as graded (results_file.sha256, fixtures).
